rendered.subject: Exploring a Collaborative Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Graza team,

We’ve been analyzing the information available about Graza and believe a collaborative Instagram post could be a really valuable opportunity.  “We” and “our” inside a quote suggest that Graza’s social content, product design, and messaging are intentionally playful and culinary-inspired, rather than overly formal.  Dickieson estimated that Graza has added around 2,000 new social followers since launching the cans.  This suggests a strong and engaged community.  We envision a post that builds on the foundation of F1 – a visual that captures the essence of Graza’s unique style.  We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post, created with Graza’s team, that would offer a fresh perspective on the brand.  The post could feature a visually appealing image or short video showcasing the product in a creative way.  We’d like to explore how this collaboration could further enhance the brand’s storytelling.

The BrandPilot team
